            adj[u].add(v)
            adj[v].add(u)
            degrees[u] += 1
            degrees[v] += 1
            edges.append(tuple(sorted((u, v))))
            
        if len(edges) == 35 and all(d >= 3 for d in degrees):
            if get_girth(adj, n) >= 7:
                return edges
    return None

result = solve()
